newsitem.title: USA: U S West wins wireless bids for 53 markets.
newsitem.headline: U S West wins wireless bids for 53 markets.

text.p: US West Inc's U S West Communications said on Monday it won licenses to provide wireless personal communications service (PCS) in 53 markets in its 14-state region.
U S West plans to integrate its PCS service with its existing wireline services, allowing customers to connect wireless phones with computers, fax machines, pagers and traditional wired telephones.
U S West expects to offer wireless service in some markets before the end of this year. It will take several years for the company to introduce it in every market where it plans to offer service.
U S West Communications won the 53 licenses last week in a Federal Communications Commission auction. U S West's winning bids totaled $57 million.
